1.bug_analyze: In the original scenario, the user wrapped the Dialog and its inner DatePicker in a <ConfigProvider popupContainer="test"> where “test” is an overflow-auto container. However, the Dialog’s child overlay (the DatePicker calendar panel) still rendered into the default root (outside of that container) and was clipped by the parent’s overflow boundary. The correct behavior is for all floating layers inside the Dialog (including DatePicker popovers) to respect the ConfigProvider’s popupContainer setting and render into the “test” div so that they aren’t hidden or clipped by the container’s scrolling/overflow.
1.patch_analyze: In the patched screenshot the calendar panel is now rendered inside the dialog’s container (the “test” div) rather than the document body.
